note: Triennial election of Newry No. 2 (County Armagh) Rural District Council, twenty-nine single-member divisions, 1958. Nominations 20 May 1958; two withdrawals (Ballybot, Killeen); six contests, polled Thursday 5 June 1958. No nomination for Moyra Castle, whose outgoing member was deemed re-elected. Labels as printed in the Newry Telegraph. Polled Thursday 5 June 1958. Printed 'Patrick Mallan' in the nominations of the result report and 'Mallon' in its figures ('Patrick Mullan' in the 24 May list). Spoiled papers: 2. The County Armagh transcription published before 7 Nov 2026 (Newry Telegraph, 7 June 1958, p. 4 ("Rural Council Elections")) read Patrick Mallan: named Patrick Mallon. Earlier transcription: "Sammon" in the Newry Reporter, "Watters" in the Newry Reporter and Armagh Guardian. The Newry Telegraph and Armagh Guardian call Waters the outgoing member, the Newry Reporter Mallon. The Newry Reporter prints 271 votes cast and 2 spoilt, but the three totals already sum to 271.
